final: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS c FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT c, c * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS sh FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.c) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.sh) AS avg_share, AVG(s.sh - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.sh > a.av
